class_vocabulary.audit-provenance: audit transcript — provenance/attachment record, no render
class_vocabulary.duplicate-of-canonical: handbook file whose normalized content equals a canonical first-class source — provenance pointers, NO render of its own
class_vocabulary.duplicate-of-handbook: handbook file whose normalized content equals another handbook file's render — pointer to that render, NO own render
class_vocabulary.first-class: spec-bearing source (build-spec, contracts, review, sections, DESIGN.md) — rendered as its own XML document
class_vocabulary.handbook-unique: handbook file whose normalized content matches no canonical render — unique normative content, rendered ONCE

dedupe.method: sha256 of the whitespace-normalized full text (' '.join(text.split())) of each canonical .md, compared against the first-class pool, then within handbook (first sorted path owns the render)
